title: Lower bound for ordinary decoding value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with $q>0$ labels, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1$, and choose a default label and a vertex. For a table of real-valued functions on the Boolean cube, each taking values in $[-1,1]$, suppose that at this vertex at least one coordinate has stable influence greater than $\varepsilon$ in the neighbor-averaged, constraint-permuted function. Then the ordinary decoding value at the vertex is at least $\varepsilon/(8q^2)$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with $q>0$ labels
A table of functions on the Boolean cube, bounded between $-1$ and $1$
A default label and a vertex
At least one neighbor-averaged notable coordinate, defined by stable influence greater than $\varepsilon$
